name: AppShell
purpose: An application shell with persistent page content, accessible landmarks and a shared mobile navigation sheet.
description: Responsive application landmarks; the host owns destinations, route state and content.

guidance.overview: An application shell with persistent page content, accessible landmarks and a shared mobile navigation sheet.
usage: Supply navigation as a renderer of real links/actions and close after successful host navigation.
Place one page inside main and use PageLayout for its body.
Keep persistent navigation state above the shell because its responsive placement remounts the slot.
accessibility: Use meaningful names and preserve the shared control keyboard behavior.
Verify the real host integration, including focus and recovery, with keyboard and assistive technology.
intent: Provide reusable application landmarks and responsive navigation without embedding a demo application or router.
context: No router, authorization, active-route matching, persisted preferences or page title management.
Navigation content remounts when switching between desktop and mobile surfaces; main content remains mounted.
The shell does not clamp overflowing arbitrary host widgets; wide tables should own their scroll region.
